results.caption:
How to choose a vitamin C serum correctly? Comment for the full list broken down by strength. 

A 20% Vitamin C serum can be weaker than a 10% formula because concentration percentages mean nothing without evaluating the active Vitamin C derivative, pH level, and antioxidant stability! Here is how popular Vitamin C serums rank based on formulation chemistry:
 Bottom Tier (Avoid / Low Stability): Generic Amazon Vitamin C serums (unlisted pH, no antioxidant support, prone to oxidation) and Arencia Vitamin C Booster Shot (5% formula with disappointing long-term results).
 Middle Tier (Best for Sensitive Skin & Beginners): RoC Multi Correxion 10% Foxtale 5% vitc + gluthathione and Deconstruct 10% (Ethyl Ascorbic Acid with antioxidant support). For ultra-sensitive skin, SeoulCeuticals Day Glow Serum (20% Ascorbyl Phosphate) provides gentle brightening without irritation.

 Top Tier (Gold Standard Brightening): Pure L-Ascorbic Acid formulas including SkinCeuticals C E Ferulic, Obagi Professional-C, Drunk Elephant C-Firma, and Timeless 20% Vitamin C + E Ferulic Acid (the best affordable alternative).
You don’t need the most expensive serum, but you must choose the right derivative for your skin tolerance and barrier health. Save this cheat sheet for your next skincare haul!
